concept.title: Adding Objects to your App
concept.shortdesc: Every app you design uses objects and fields. Complete the tasks on this page to add objects to your app and define which fields from those objects you want to work with.

note.p: Click on an image on this page to enlarge the view.
Before you can add objects to your app, you need to create the app file. Refer to Designing Apps for instructions to create your app.
